searchText: Are delay encryption and/or homomorphic timelock puzzles solved pragmatically, or only theoretically? Actually, just delay encryption. I think that is *exactly* what I need. It’s at the boundary between theoretical and practical 🙂 Someone could probably put in the R&D effort but we’re talking about a multimillion project by a dedicated team. That isn't what I would consider "at the boundary". 😬 But I appreciate the honest answer. 🙂
